:::info

La documentación de esta integración la escribe su autor y, por ahora, solo está disponible en inglés.

:::

This integration lets you control your **Freebox** from Gladys Assistant, directly over your local network, with no cloud involved.

## Features

- **Freebox home automation**: opening sensors, motion sensors, battery level, tamper contacts, roller shutters (state and position), alarm control panel (arm, disarm, state) and alarm keyfob.
- **Freebox Players** (compatible models, see below): power, volume, mute, **tuning a channel by its number**, media control (play/pause, stop, previous, next, rewind and fast forward) and remote control keys (channel up/down, TV, home, guide, info, record, arrow keys, OK and back).

  ℹ️ **"Next" / "Previous" do not change channel**: they are media commands (track or chapter of what is playing). To zap, use **"Channel"** (direct number), or **"Channel up"** / **"Channel down"**.

  ℹ️ **"Play" and "Pause" act as a toggle**: the Freebox API exposes a single `play_pause` command for both, so the two buttons do the same thing.

  ℹ️ **"Mute" is a toggle too**: each press mutes or restores the sound based on the player's real state, read right before the command is sent.

  ⚠️ **Some keys are not guaranteed.** Only volume, mute, tuning by channel number and the main media commands rely on the API documented by Free. Power and the navigation keys (arrows, OK, back, home, guide, info, channel up/down) press a key of the virtual remote, an **undocumented** endpoint that may stop working after a Freebox update.

  ℹ️ Media commands depend on what the player is currently playing: on the home screen, with no active media, they may have **no effect**. Use the navigation keys to start a channel or a piece of content first.

- **Freebox cameras**: image shown on the dashboard (refreshed every minute) and on demand, captured from the video stream with ffmpeg.
- **Actions**: pair, test the connection, reboot the Freebox and unpair, right from the configuration screen.

## Requirements

- A Freebox (Delta, Ultra, Pop, Revolution...) with the home automation server enabled.
- Gladys Assistant and this integration must run on the **same local network** as the Freebox (access to `mafreebox.freebox.fr`).

## Pairing

1. Open the Freebox integration configuration screen in Gladys.
2. Click the **"Pair with the Freebox"** button.
3. Walk to your Freebox Server: its LCD screen shows an authorization request. Press the **right arrow** to confirm.
4. The pairing is remembered: you only need to do it once.

⏱️ **You have about 55 seconds** to press the right arrow on the LCD screen. After that delay, pairing fails with the message "authorization was not confirmed on the LCD screen": just run the **"Pair with the Freebox"** action again. Make sure you are standing next to your Freebox **before** clicking the button.

## Permissions to enable (important)

After pairing, open your Freebox settings:

**Freebox OS > Settings > Access management > Applications > Gladys Assistant**

and **enable** the following permissions:

- **Home automation and alarm management** (sensors, shutters, alarm)
- **Camera access**
- **Freebox Player control**
- **Freebox settings modification**: only needed by the "Reboot the Freebox" action.

⚠️ Without these boxes ticked, the matching devices will **not appear** during discovery. This is the most common cause of a missing device.

Once the permissions are granted, run a device scan: Gladys will list every device detected on your Freebox. Pick the ones you want to create.

## Freebox Player POP / Android TV limitation

**Freebox Player POP** units (and other **Android TV**-based players) are **not controllable** through this integration: Free does not expose the local control API on those models (the player is reported with `api_available: false` and is therefore skipped). To control a Player POP, use an **Android TV** integration (ADB protocol), which is out of scope here.

The Players of the **Delta** and **Revolution** Freebox (which expose the local player API) remain fully controllable.

## Rebooting the Freebox

The **"Reboot the Freebox"** action on the configuration screen restarts your Freebox Server. There is no shutdown action: the Freebox API only exposes a reboot (a powered-off box could not be turned back on remotely).

## Troubleshooting

- **"Freebox not found on the local network"** (or `ENOTFOUND mafreebox.freebox.fr`): Gladys cannot reach `mafreebox.freebox.fr`. Check that Gladys runs behind the Freebox (not behind another router) and that this address resolves on your network.
- **A device is missing from the scan**: the matching permission is not ticked in Freebox OS (see above). Tick it, then scan again.
- **"Freebox session could not be opened"**: the authorization was revoked in Freebox OS. Click **"Unpair"**, then **"Pair with the Freebox"** again.
- **Reboot refused**: the "Freebox settings modification" permission is not ticked.
- **No camera image**: check that the camera shows its stream in Freebox OS. The image is refreshed every minute; the live view captures a new one on demand.

## Parámetros de configuración

Estos son los parámetros que Freebox te pide en su pantalla de configuración en Gladys.

| Parámetro | Tipo | Obligatorio | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Conecte su Freebox | `section` | No | Esta integración se comunica con su Freebox Server a través de su red local. Para vincularla, haga clic abajo en «Vincular con la Freebox» y confirme después la autorización directamente en la pantalla LCD de su Freebox Server (flecha derecha de la caja). Dispone de unos 55 segundos para confirmar: colóquese junto a su Freebox antes de hacer clic; si el plazo expira, simplemente vuelva a lanzar la acción. La vinculación solo se hace una vez. |
| Conceda los permisos | `section` | No | Tras la vinculación, abra los ajustes de su Freebox (Freebox OS > Settings > Access management > Applications > Gladys Assistant) y active los permisos Domótica, Cámara y Player. Sin ellos, los dispositivos correspondientes no aparecerán durante la búsqueda. La acción «Reiniciar la Freebox» necesita además el permiso de modificación de los ajustes de la Freebox. |

## Cómo instalar Freebox en Gladys

1. En Gladys, abre **Integraciones**: Freebox aparece en el catálogo junto a las integraciones nativas, con una insignia de comunidad.
2. Haz clic en **Instalar**. Gladys descarga la imagen Docker (`ghcr.io/william-de71/gladys-freebox:1.2.0`), la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo y genera la interfaz de la integración (dispositivos, descubrimiento y configuración).
3. Abre la pantalla de **Configuración** de la integración, rellena los parámetros y guarda.
4. También puedes instalarla directamente desde la URL de su repositorio: [https://github.com/William-De71/gladys-freebox](https://github.com/William-De71/gladys-freebox).

Freebox requiere Gladys `>=4.86.0`. El catálogo de Gladys se actualiza cada hora, así que una nueva versión está disponible como máximo una hora después de publicarse.

¿Todavía no usas Gladys? Es gratuito y de código abierto: [sigue la guía de instalación](/es/docs/) para empezar.

## Sobre las integraciones externas

Freebox es una **integración externa**: una integración comunitaria empaquetada como contenedor Docker y publicada en GitHub. Gladys la instala con un clic y la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo. La publica y mantiene [William-De71](https://github.com/William-De71), no el equipo principal de Gladys.
